wholePhysicalScope: Named mosque outline at Constanza Bastion, the exact 13 April 1999 CC0 Qualla photograph and the Nicosia municipality’s monument description.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the tiled hall and the limestone minaret with its corbelled balcony. Near levels retain the stone arches, window jambs, and roof trim.
limitations: The reconstruction covers the mosque as photographed in April 1999. Constanza Bastion is recorded for geographic context.
The source elevation field resolves the hilltop grade at low resolution. Local wall footings and approaches use estimated heights.
The south-facing walls and minaret proportions follow the published photograph. Positions of individual openings, far wall details and roof connections are approximations.
